title: The Apple Pie Bake-Off
story: Rosa judged the apple pie bake-off at the Salt & Sugar Bakery, and four pies came out of the ovens smelling like October itself. Each baker chose a different crust and a different spice, and each pie spent a different time in the oven. Rosa wants the secrets for her recipe box, and she has promised not to tell her sourdough starters. Who made which crust, with which spice, and how long did each pie bake?

texts: Of the baker with the crumble crust and the baker whose pie baked 55 minutes, one added nutmeg and the other added ginger.
The baker who added cardamom baked longer than the baker who added ginger.
Imani baked for a shorter time than the baker with the lattice crust.
Priya did not make a plain crust.
The baker with the lattice crust baked exactly 5 minutes longer than the baker who added ginger.
Of Vito and the baker whose pie baked 40 minutes, one made a crumble crust and the other made a braided crust.
The baker with the lattice crust baked for 50 minutes.
